band.description: a depth/length band extracted from the description (e.g. "up to 23.0 metres")

citation.description: the source workbook path, sheet name and line reference

composite.description: the unit could not be normalised to a known alias, so the rate is a composite

counterparty.description: the party the submission was made to

derived_rate_per_m.description: `rate / band.max` for an each-unit line with a band

qty.description: the quantity on the priced line, when the template exposes one

rate_family.description: the rate-book bucket, classified from the sheet name and unit

revision.description: the submission revision the agent recorded

submitted_at.description: when the priced schedule was submitted

unit_normalized.description: the controlled unit of measure the rate is per

unit_raw.description: the unit exactly as written in the workbook

work_activity.description: a v2 taxonomy classification of the work

work_item.description: the description of the priced line, as written in the submission
